core_meaning.primary_meaning: Safee is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pure, clear”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Safee corresponds to the Arabic form صَفِي (Arabic root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w); صَفِي (Ṣafī)). Its core sense is safee; pure, clear. Safee is a spelling variant of Arabic صَفِي (Ṣafī) 'pure, clear', from the root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w). The source gloss 'Secure, Safe, Protected' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as safi.
